matchedPathReference: Fixed accepted share quantities/timing; previous close to current open gap PnL plus current open to close PnL at fixed FX. Equals final equity plus recorded fees/tax/slippage. Not an independent signal benchmark, cost-free rerun or same percentage exposure.
limitations: Retrospective diagnostics on already observed frozen prices; no parameter selection/optimization
2026 observations reserved and not used in this run; this is not out-of-sample significance evidence
Three correlated selected ETFs; calendar/corporate-action coverage not independently verified
Same original 2023Q1 quantity including original 10bp cost-buffer sizing, frozen across both costs and every quarter; target15% differs from actual integer-share exposure
Quarter reset rows are separate10000000KRW accounts, never summed or compounded into continuous performance

entryPolicy.momentum: 100*(current/lookback_previous−1), original inclusive >=positive threshold and <=negative threshold comparisons retained
entryPolicy.level: Buy only flat and Sell only actually owned; observations never manufacture confirmed ownership
entryPolicy.crossing: Previous momentum <5 and current >=5; entry armed at momentum <=5-hysteresis_pct; candidate retry while momentum>=5 until actual owned quantity>0
entryPolicy.hysteresis: 1 percentage point rearming band, <=4 then upward inclusive5 crossing; not relative1%
entryPolicy.exit: All current variants retain owned negative level (<=−5) exit. Guard rejection/provider failure/partial sell cannot consume held exit
entryPolicy.feedback: same0 quantity publication or nextOpen pending is not successful fill; positive quantity consumes entry candidate; partial positive remains held
entryPolicy.warmup: Strict previous bars seed previous momentum/arming without orders or candidate executions; no future bars
entryPolicy.crossingCandidateCancellation: Momentum<threshold cancels retry; hysteresis rearm requires <=threshold−band; between4and5 cancels but does not rearm 1pp
entryPolicy.reconfiguration: Same identity preserves actual owned quantity/history; candidate settings changes invalidate pending interpretation and reseed safely without invented fills
entryPolicy.inactiveHysteresis: level accepts finite0..100 stored draft but ignores the band explicitly; crossing additionally requires band<=threshold

compatibility.description: Non-Momentum complete backtest/signals exact. Momentum raw/accepted/cash differences explicitly measured; not forced to match faulty legacy ownership behavior.

protocolCorrectionsBeforeRuns: Independent source audit corrected an initial strict-boundary assumption before any candidate run.86a9829 uses >=/<=; original inclusive thresholds retained.
